{"Author":"Faye, Kage","Name":"Better Occult Crescent & Chest Helper Interface","InternalName":"BOCCHI","Punchline":"BOCCHI is here to smooth out your Occult Crescent experience.","Description":"BOCCHI is here to smooth out your Occult Crescent experience.

  /bocchi config → Opens config (aliases: cfg, c)

  /bocchi config set <key> <value> → Sets a config value

  /bocchi cmd flag-active-fate → Flag a FATE on the map
  /bocchi cmd flag-active-non-pot-fate → Flag a non-pot FATE
